title: BEST CREEPER FARM In Minecraft Bedrock 1.21 - MCPE/Xbox/PS4/Nintendo Switch/Windows10
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make the next generation of the creeper farm in Minecraft Bedrock that can produce 1 stack per minute using a new system installed in this farm that can transfer creepers under 0.7s, making this farm 30x faster than any creeper farm you've ever seen in Minecraft.

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond levels of bedrock, so be sure to turn on the notification to be notified!
